note: Game facts only (numbers and variable names, no text). vars = CanonicalVars base values; upgrade.vars = amount added by one upgrade (OnUpgrade), costDelta = energy cost change, add/removeKeywords = keyword changes. calculated: value shown out of combat = vars[base]; in combat it is vars[base] + vars[extra] x a runtime count. unresolved = variables only known at runtime. contextVars = variables CardModel.GetDescriptionForPile adds to every card description. Regenerate: dotnet run --project tools/CatalogBuilder -- --card-vars data/catalog/card-vars.<version>.json [--loc <localization dir> to also check the templates]

contextVars.IfUpgraded: IfUpgradedVar: {IfUpgraded:show:upgraded|normal} picks the first branch on an upgraded card (green in the upgrade preview), else the second
contextVars.OnTable: bool: the card is in hand or being played
contextVars.InCombat: bool: a combat is running and the card is in a combat pile (false in rewards, shop, deck view, library)
contextVars.IsTargeting: bool: the card is currently aimed at a target
contextVars.TargetType: string: the card's TargetType enum name (AnyEnemy, Self, ...)
contextVars.IsOstyAlive: bool: the owner's Osty is alive (Necrobinder); false outside a run
contextVars.energyPrefix: string: energy icon colour of the card's pool (ironclad, silent, ..., colorless); used as {energyPrefix:energyIcons(n)} = n energy icons
contextVars.singleStarIcon: string: one star icon image tag
